title.en: Mendel's laws and the monohybrid cross

heading.en: Why do you look like your parents?

hook.en: A monk growing peas in a monastery garden counted thousands of plants and found the rules that decide how traits pass from parents to children.
hook.kn: ಮಠದ ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಟಾಣಿ ಬೆಳೆಸಿದ ಸನ್ಯಾಸಿ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಸಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಎಣಿಸಿ ಅನುವಂಶೀಯತೆಯ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದರು.

narration.en: A monk growing peas in a monastery garden counted thousands of plants and found the rules that decide how traits pass from parents to children.
narration.kn: ಮಠದ ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಟಾಣಿ ಬೆಳೆಸಿದ ಸನ್ಯಾಸಿ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಸಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಎಣಿಸಿ ಅನುವಂಶೀಯತೆಯ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದರು.

body.en: Gregor Mendel did hybridisation experiments on garden peas for seven years (1856–1863). He used true-breeding lines and studied seven pairs of contrasting traits, such as tall and dwarf stems, and he analysed large samples statistically. A gene is the unit of inheritance; its slightly different forms are alleles. TT and tt are homozygous, Tt is heterozygous.
body.kn: ಗ್ರೆಗರ್ ಮೆಂಡೆಲ್ 1856–1863ರಲ್ಲಿ ಬಟಾಣಿ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಏಳು ಜೊತೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದರು. ಜೀನ್ ಅನುವಂಶೀಯತೆಯ ಘಟಕ; ಅದರ ರೂಪಗಳು ಅಲೀಲ್‌ಗಳು.

points.en: Seven pairs of contrasting traits in pea

narration.en: Gregor Mendel did hybridisation experiments on garden peas for seven years (1856–1863). He used true-breeding lines and studied seven pairs of contrasting traits, such as tall and dwarf stems, and he analysed large samples statistically. A gene is the unit of inheritance; its slightly different forms are alleles. TT and tt are homozygous, Tt is heterozygous.
narration.kn: ಗ್ರೆಗರ್ ಮೆಂಡೆಲ್ 1856–1863ರಲ್ಲಿ ಬಟಾಣಿ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಏಳು ಜೊತೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದರು. ಜೀನ್ ಅನುವಂಶೀಯತೆಯ ಘಟಕ; ಅದರ ರೂಪಗಳು ಅಲೀಲ್‌ಗಳು.

body.en: Crossing tall (TT) with dwarf (tt) gives all tall F1 (Tt): tall is dominant, dwarf is recessive. Selfing F1 gives F2 in the phenotypic ratio 3 tall : 1 dwarf and the genotypic ratio 1 TT : 2 Tt : 1 tt. Law of dominance: in a heterozygote only the dominant factor is expressed. Law of segregation: the two alleles separate during gamete formation, so each gamete gets only one. A test cross with the recessive parent reveals the unknown genotype: 1 : 1 means heterozygous, all dominant means homozygous.
body.kn: ಎತ್ತರ (TT) × ಕುಳ್ಳ (tt) → F1 ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಎತ್ತರ (Tt). F2ನಲ್ಲಿ ಲಕ್ಷಣ ಅನುಪಾತ 3:1, ಜೀನ್ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಅನುಪಾತ 1:2:1. ಪ್ರಬಲತೆಯ ನಿಯಮ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕತೆಯ ನಿಯಮ. ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಕರಣದಿಂದ ಅಜ್ಞಾತ ಜೀನ್ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

aim.en: To verify the law of segregation with a monohybrid cross and a test cross.

narration.en: Let us cross true-breeding tall and dwarf plants on the virtual bench, count the F2, and then do a test cross to find a hidden genotype.

problem.en: A tall pea plant of unknown genotype is crossed with a dwarf plant. Of 120 offspring, 61 are tall and 59 are dwarf. What is the genotype of the tall parent?

steps.en: The cross with the recessive dwarf (tt) is a test cross.
If the tall parent were TT, all offspring would be tall (Tt).
Here the ratio is about 1 : 1, which happens only if the tall parent gives T and t gametes equally.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A tall pea plant of unknown genotype is crossed with a dwarf plant. Of 120 offspring, 61 are tall and 59 are dwarf. What is the genotype of the tall parent?

problem.en: In the F2 of a monohybrid cross, 800 plants are obtained. How many are expected to be (a) dwarf, (b) homozygous tall, (c) heterozygous tall?

steps.en: Genotypic ratio 1 TT : 2 Tt : 1 tt, so each quarter is 800 ÷ 4 = 200.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. In the F2 of a monohybrid cross, 800 plants are obtained. How many are expected to be (a) dwarf, (b) homozygous tall, (c) heterozygous tall?

A test cross with the recessive parent reveals the genotype.

homework.en: Draw a Punnett square for Tt × Tt and write the phenotypic and genotypic ratios.

narration.en: Recap. Mendel studied seven pairs of contrasting traits in pea. F2 ratios: phenotype 3 : 1, genotype 1 : 2 : 1. Alleles segregate in gamete formation; each gamete gets one. A test cross with the recessive parent reveals the genotype.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮೆಂಡೆಲ್ ಬಟಾಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಏಳು ಜೊತೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದರು. F2 ಅನುಪಾತ: ಲಕ್ಷಣ 3:1, ಜೀನ್ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ 1:2:1. ಗ್ಯಾಮೀಟ್ ರಚನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಲೀಲ್‌ಗಳು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ. ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಕರಣ ಜೀನ್ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
